networking.k8s.io/v1 is not a rename of the apiVersion: spec.backend becomes spec.defaultBackend, a backend's serviceName becomes service.name and its servicePort becomes service.port.number (numeric) or service.port.name (string), and pathType (Prefix, Exact or ImplementationSpecific, which matches the undefined v1beta1 behaviour) is required on every path

apiextensions.k8s.io/v1 is not a rename of the apiVersion: spec.scope must be set (it no longer defaults to Namespaced), spec.version, spec.validation, spec.subresources and spec.additionalPrinterColumns move under spec.versions[*], each version needs a structural spec.versions[*].schema.openAPIV3Schema, spec.preserveUnknownFields: true is disallowed (use x-kubernetes-preserve-unknown-fields: true in the schema), and spec.conversion.webhookClientConfig moves to spec.conversion.webhook.clientConfig

admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1 is not a rename of the apiVersion: webhooks[*].sideEffects (None or NoneOnDryRun) and webhooks[*].admissionReviewVersions (v1 and v1beta1 are supported) are required and have no default, webhooks[*].name must be unique in the list, and the defaults change: failurePolicy Fail (was Ignore), matchPolicy Equivalent (was Exact), timeoutSeconds 10 (was 30)

admissionregistration.k8s.io/v1 is not a rename of the apiVersion: webhooks[*].sideEffects (None or NoneOnDryRun) and webhooks[*].admissionReviewVersions (v1 and v1beta1 are supported) are required and have no default, webhooks[*].name must be unique in the list, and the defaults change: failurePolicy Fail (was Ignore), matchPolicy Equivalent (was Exact), timeoutSeconds 10 (was 30)

certificates.k8s.io/v1 requires spec.signerName (kubernetes.io/legacy-unknown requests cannot be created) and spec.usages with no duplicates and only known usages; approvers and signers must not repeat a condition type, set status.conditions[*].status, and write a PEM-encoded status.certificate of CERTIFICATE blocks only

events.k8s.io/v1 is not a rename of the apiVersion: type is only Normal or Warning, involvedObject becomes regarding, action, reason, reportingController and reportingInstance are required on new events, and eventTime, series.lastObservedTime and series.count replace firstTimestamp, lastTimestamp and count
in policy/v1 an empty spec.selector ({}) selects every pod in the namespace, where in v1beta1 it selected none; an unset selector still selects none
discovery.k8s.io/v1 replaces topology with the per-endpoint nodeName and zone fields (deprecatedTopology is not writable)
